equity.level_reason: Homelessness defines the population studied; no group comparisons by any SPD are made. Structural risks (crowding, access to care) are named only as background explanation.

level_alternative.reason: Homelessness is a social position and lack of access to care is offered as explanation, which a reader might count as equity raised without group results.
